templates.name: Decode Basic Auth
templates.description: Detect Basic credentials in Authorization / Proxy-Authorization headers and user:pass@ URL userinfo. Logs decoded username and password without changing the request.

templates.name: User-Agent Switcher
templates.description: Rewrite the User-Agent request header on matching traffic. Edit setHeaders to the string you want. Applies to navigations/subresources via webRequest and to fetch/XHR via the privileged-header rewrite. Does not spoof navigator.userAgent or Client Hints in page JS.
